The Treasury's average rate on its debt is currently 3.52%, which is higher than the target range of 3-3/4 to 4 percent. The staff's forecast shows that the federal debt will rise by 0.1 point in the next two years, with core inflation higher by 0.1 point. Markets expect further increases over the next two years, with the 2-year yield being 0.9 points above the middle of the target range. The consumer-impact rubric is not implemented yet, but the current direction is up.]
